checks.label: committed on feature/inventory-persistence, main untouched
command: test "$(git branch --show-current)" = feature/inventory-persistence && test "$(git rev-list --count main)" = 1 && test "$(git rev-list --count main..HEAD)" -ge 1

checks.label: nothing left uncommitted (besides the harness's own files)
the commit touches only the package and its tests, with a real message
command: files=$(git diff --name-only main..HEAD); test -n "$files" && ! echo "$files" | grep -vE '^(inventory|tests)/' && test "$(git log -1 --format=%s | wc -c)" -gt 10
